global: This is a bowl of tanmen, featuring a clear, light broth with thin noodles, shredded cabbage, and slices of pork. The white bowl has a blue Greek key pattern, set on a wooden table under warm, ambient lighting.

regions.background: Wooden table surface shows warm brown tones, visible grain patterns, and smooth texture beneath the bowl.
regions.bowl: White ceramic ramen bowl with black Greek key pattern and Japanese text along its rim.
regions.soup: The tonkotsu (pork bone) broth is light brown, glossy, and contains thin noodles, cabbage, and meat pieces.
